input: Find a local language exchange partner for Mandarin

gold.taskTitle: Find a Local Mandarin Language Exchange Partner
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find a local partner to practice Mandarin through a language exchange arrangement.

questions.title: What is your current Mandarin proficiency level?
questions.description: Understanding the user's level (beginner, intermediate, advanced) to match with an appropriate partner.

questions.title: Which language would you offer in exchange?
questions.description: Identifying what language the user can teach their exchange partner in return.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood are you based in?
questions.description: Pinpointing the user's location to find truly local partners nearby.

questions.title: Do you prefer meeting in person or online?
questions.description: Clarifying whether 'local' means face-to-face meetups or if virtual sessions are acceptable.

questions.title: How often do you want to meet each week?
questions.description: Understanding the desired frequency of sessions to set expectations with a potential partner.

questions.title: Is there a specific Mandarin dialect or focus you need?
questions.description: Determining whether the user wants standard Mandarin, a regional dialect, or a specific focus like business or HSK prep.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred platform or method to find partners?
questions.description: Checking if the user already has platforms in mind (Meetup, Tandem, local community centres) or needs suggestions.
